content:
Consider adding 'Reverse mode is turned on' to the top of the Goal while the puzzle is in WIP. I ruined it for myself by reading the statement first.

5DN1L pretty much already mentioned this, but I would like to see more cases where there are multiple win streaks of different lengths, as only test 1 and validator 4 match that criteria currently.

Formatting / presentation
* Please study the formatting syntax described on this page: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement , and format the statement properly as described in the points below.

Goal
* Please format "W" and "L" as {{constants}}.

Input
* Please format "Line 1" and "Line 2" in <<bold>>.

* Please format both instances of "N" as a [[variable]].

* Please format "W" and "L" as {{constants}}.

* Please add "being the result of a match" at the end of the description of Line 2.

Output
* Please change "One line with" to "<<One line>>:".

* Please format "0 0" as a {{constant}}.

Constraints
* Please format "N" as a [[variable]].

* Please change 100 to 99 (for the purpose of Shortest mode).

Stub generator
* Please change 100 to 99 (for the purpose of Shortest mode).

Cases
* Please add a pair of cases that satisfy both of the following conditions:
  • 30 < N < 40
  • [[results]] contains W only.

* Please add a pair of cases that satisfy both of the following conditions:
  • N > 50
  • [[results]] = a streak of L (10 ≤ length ≤ 15) + a streak of W + another streak of L (10 ≤ length ≤ 15)

Thanks.

Hi 5DN1L, thanks a lot for the detailed review! I've applied all the requested changes: statement formatting ({{constants}}, [[variables]], <<bold>>), the added "being the result of a match" in the Line 2 description, the Output rewording, N <= 99 in the constraints and in the stub generator, and the two new pairs of cases (N between 31 and 39 with W only, and N > 50 with a streak of L + a streak of W + a streak of L). Could you please take another look when you have a moment? Thanks!

Hi MGTRFELIPEURREGO, the revisions look good to me. It'd be helpful to add one more pair of cases that satisfy the following conditions:

* N > 60

* Many short streaks of L and W, with a variety of random lengths between 2 and 5, and no regular pattern (as can be found in e.g. Pair 4)

* The number of longest streaks > 1

Thanks.
